Documentation generation now fails explicitly below the irreducible 15-character Mermaid source size; the exact minimum produces valid bounded output.
Diagram truncation diagnostics remain machine-readable and are rendered deterministically in generated Markdown.
Material and participant budgets now admit a chronological message prefix, stop at first cumulative overflow, and preserve branch, sequence, and participant closure.
Traversal now uses explicit deterministic DFS work frames; a 1024-target chain reaches the exact evidence-backed default method-budget boundary without stack overflow.
